vacantes.title: Staff Software Engineer - Mexico
vacantes.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Engineering team helps Nu create and scale the technology that powers the best financial products in Latin America. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, using a variety of technologies and architectures to build resilient, secure, and highly scalable systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of multiple teams, driving the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems that serve millions of customers. While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

You will build and evolve:

 - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

 - High-throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

 - Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS

 - Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB

 - Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

 - Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.


YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Working with large-scale distributed systems and understanding their broad architecture and trade-offs

 - Setting technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

 - Driving pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient, secure, and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

 - Mentoring engineers across teams and helping maintain a high technical bar organization-wide

 - Writing, testing, instrumenting, documenting, and maintaining high-quality code

 - Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your teams

 - Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

 - Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across team services

 - Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

 - Focusing primarily on backend applications, while being open to contributing to mobile and frontend development according to business needs


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - At least 8 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

 - A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

 - A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams, even without direct authority

 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

 - Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

 - Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks,

vacantes.title: Senior Business Analyst
vacantes.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog https://building.nubank.com.br and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

 - Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

 - Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

 - Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python, Databricks and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

 - Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

 - Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

 - Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

 - Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

 - Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

 - Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

 - Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

 - Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

 - Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

 - Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

 - Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Core Benefits

 - Chance of earning equity at Nu

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Health and life insurance

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - Vacations of 17 workdays with 25% vacation bonus

 - Gym partnership

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

 - Food card

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Role Location

Mexico City, MX

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Internal Communications Sr Specialist position, based in Mexico City, plays a pivotal role in planning and delivering clear, engaging, and consistent communications for Nu employees in Mexico. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in internal communications, executive communications, content development, employee engagement, and change communications. They will understand how to adapt messages for different employee audiences and channels, while working effectively across teams and cultures. They will be a self-starter with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, strong editorial judgment, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Internal Communications Strategy: Develop and execute internal communication strategies and plans that connect company priorities, business updates, and organizational initiatives to employees in a clear, timely, and engaging way.

 - Employee Channels and Content: Create, edit, and publish content for internal channels, including slack posts, internal announcements, presentations, talking points, FAQs, and other employee-facing materials.

 - Executive Communications: Prepare executives and senior leaders for internal communications, including all-hands meetings, leadership messages, organizational updates, and employee Q&A sessions. Help leaders communicate with clarity, empathy, and consistency.

 - Change Communications: Design communication plans that support organizational, operational, cultural, and business changes. Translate complex information into accessible messages and equip leaders and teams to navigate change effectively.

 - Employee Engagement: Partner with Human Resources to develop initiatives and communication moments that strengthen employee connection, participation, understanding of company priorities, and alignment with Nu’s mission and values.

 - Internal Issues and Crisis Communications: Support timely, accurate, and coordinated communication with employees during sensitive situations, business disruptions, or organizational changes, in partnership with relevant internal stakeholders.

 - Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong partnerships with People, Culture, Product, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and other internal teams to gather information, align messages, and ensure consistency across employee communications.

 - Editorial Planning and Governance: Manage editorial calendars, communication workflows, approvals, and message consistency across internal channels. Establish clear standards for tone, timing, accessibility, and audience relevance.

 - Measurement and Insights: Monitor the reach, engagement, and effectiveness of internal communication initiatives. Use employee feedback and communication data to improve content, channels, and future plans.

 - Cross-cultural Collaboration: Partner with communications colleagues and stakeholders across Nu’s markets to share best practices and adapt global messages to the Mexican employee context.

 


WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - Solid experience in internal communications, ideally in the technology, financial, or consumer sectors.

 - Experience developing and executing internal communication plans with agility, accountability, and strong attention to detail.

 - Experience supporting executive communications, employee engagement, change communications, or organizational communications

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ensure Nubank’s sustainable growth by maintaining rigorous compliance with financial secrecy regulations and authority requirements in Mexico. In this role, you will be a key operator within our Judicial Orders & Regulatory Attention team, acting as the primary bridge for official communications from the CNBV (Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores), fiscal, administrative, and judicial authorities.

You will play a pivotal role in managing end-to-end operational workflows via the SITI AA portal, ensuring 100% compliance with statutory deadlines for information requests, account freezing/unfreezing (aseguramiento y desbloqueo de cuentas), fund transfers, and the enforcement of the Blocked Person List (Lista de Personas Bloqueadas).

 - Authority Enquiries & Judicial Orders: Analyzing, processing, and responding to official subpoenas, information requests, and documentation requirements from CNBV, SAT, FGR, and competent judicial/administrative authorities.

 - Account Asset Orders: Executing regulatory actions regarding account freezing (aseguramiento), unfreezing (desbloqueo), and asset transfers in accordance with Mexican banking laws and CNBV mandates.

 - Continuous Process Improvement: Partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Tech teams to automate SITI AA routines, refine operational controls, and adapt workflows to regulatory updates (CNBV / SOFIPO framework).

 - Audit & Archiving Readiness: Documenting decisions, responses, and execution proofs to maintain traceable audit trails for regulatory inspections and internal reviews.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Direct Experience with SITI AA: Proven hands-on experience managing and executing requirements via CNBV’s SITI AA system in the Mexican financial sector (Banking, SOFIPOs, or Fintechs).

 - Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of financial secrecy laws (secreto bancario/financiero), CNBV regulations, and legal procedures for judicial orders and account freezing/unfreezing.

 - Analytical & Detail-Oriented Mindset: Exceptional precision in handling sensitive customer data, legal documents, and official authority templates under tight, non-negotiable regulatory deadlines.

 - Process Discipline: Comfort with high-volume operational workflows, maintaining high accuracy and compliance even within bureaucratic and structured regulatory frameworks.

 - Data & BI Literacy: Familiarity with queue management and data visualization tools (Excel, Google Sheets, Looker) to monitor performance and tracking metrics.

 - Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (required for official authority responses) and English/Portuguese (for internal stakeholders).

OUR COMPLIANCE CHAPTER

The Compliance Team has a very special role in our mission: support the company’s growth by identifying the regulatory risks that NU faces; designing and implementing controls to protect Nu from such risks; and by providing advisory to the Business on regulations and internal policies to create the best product or service that follows with these external and internal regulations and standards.

Responsibilities assigned to you might be related to:

 - Research regulations and project management for its implementation.

 - Project management related to new regulations and licensing processes.

 - Lead efforts and align requirements towards new financial licenses.

 - Evaluate from a compliance perspective new products and features to be launched.

 - Keep other teams abreast of requirements by researching regulatory and filing information; writing and communicating guidelines.

 - Provide advisory to other teams about the regulation to establish new processes or controls.

 - Monitor and respond to inquiries received from Regulators, Auto Regulatory bodies or Auditors.

 - Create and update Compliance policies and procedures.

 - Liaise and work closely with various teams to enhance systems and processes related to Compliance.

 - Coordinate or support regulatory reviews or audits.

 - Support in identifying regulatory gaps and tracking its implementation.

We believe in

 - Entrepreneurship spirit;

 - Exceptional team chemistry;

 - Ownership

How We Work

 - You act like you own the company where you work

 - You are enthusiastic about building partnership with other teams

 - You are willing to go the extra mile and getting involved in many areas

 - You challenge the status quo

 - You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, results-oriented teams

 - You are hungry and enjoy being constantly challenged to learn and do more



Requirements

 - +7 years' or above experience in regulatory compliance,  AML or regulatory areas for Banks, SOFIPO and/or Fintechs.

 - Proven experience in filing and obtention of financial licenses such as Fintech or Bank and project management for that.

 - Experience with CNBV & Banxico regulatory requirements for Financial Institutions.

 - Ability to develop policies and procedures from scratch and implement them.

 - Ability to conduct regulatory advisory and law interpretation by providing consultation to business areas as well as internal clients.

 - Ability to tackle complex problems involving several topics/variables, such as business, regulatory, finance and product.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every Nubank office runs on an IT Room that most people never see. Power distribution, cooling, structured cabling and fiber are the layer that keeps thousands of Nubankers connected and working — and when that layer fails, entire sites stop.

Nubank's office portfolio is growing across countries, and today each site has been built to its own standard. The ETS team owns the physical layer of these environments — structured cabling, optical fiber and, in partnership with other teams, power distribution, HVAC, fire protection and physical security systems. This role exists to bring one engineering standard to all of them.

As Lead Infrastructure Engineer for Global Office IT Physical Infra, you are the technical reference for IT Room infrastructure across Nubank's global office portfolio. You assess and size environments, define the technical specifications new sites and expansions must meet, and coordinate the vendors and construction teams who build them — so that an IT Room in Mexico City, São Paulo or Miami is built, documented and operated the same way.

vacantes.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE TEAM

Mexico FP&A is the finance partner of the Mexico business. We sit between the product, credit, growth and marketing teams and the country leadership, and our job is to make sure every bet the business makes is sized, challenged and reflected in the P&L before it is made.

We are not a reporting team. We work hand in hand with Credit Card, Lending, Cuenta (deposits and transactional) and Growth stakeholders, as well as Treasury, Controllership, Public Policy, Second Line Risk and Investor Relations, to turn strategy into numbers and numbers into decisions.

How we work

 - We are owners: we make things happen instead of waiting for them.

 - We have a bias to output: fast, right-sized answers over months-long projects.

 - We set the finance agenda, not only serve it.

 - We embrace conflicting ideas and question the status quo, with data.

 - We work hard, with integrity and putting the team first.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the IC7 in Mexico FP&A for credit products and strategic planning, you are the senior analytical bridge between Mexico's credit products, the P&L and the planning process. You do not run closings or own the budget calendar. You own something harder: making sure what goes into the plan is grounded, challenged and financially sound, and that leadership decides with the right numbers in front of them.

The role has three faces. You are a business partner to Credit Card, Lending, Cuenta, Growth and Core, who challenges their strategy and helps them bake initiatives into the plan. You are a first responder who quantifies, within days, anything that hits the P&L that wasn't planned. And you are a decision shaper who builds the frameworks, tools and governance leadership uses to decide.

At this level you set the finance agenda rather than wait for requests. You work directly with the country CEO, CFO and business-unit leaders, move between hands-on modeling and executive framing in the same week, and raise the analytical bar of the team around you.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Partner with product teams and bake their initiatives into the plan

 - Understand the projections of Credit Card, Lending, Cuenta, Growth and Core teams and challenge the strategy behind them: assumptions, timing, certainty and whether the impact is really incremental.

 - Help teams translate initiatives into P&L impact when they don't know how, and carry them into budget, rebudget, forecast checkpoints and the 5-year plan.

 - Size initiatives with a consistent toolkit (NPV, CAC, payback, ROAS, gross profit) and apply clear inclusion criteria.

 - Push back when a plan doesn't add up and perform deep dives proactively, for example recommending not to launch a program until its economics are positive, and proposing alternatives such as phased rollouts or test budgets.

2. React fast to anything that hits the P&L unplanned

 - Be the first to quantify regulatory and market shocks.

 - Turn the impact into options: mitigation levers, owners and dates, not only a number.

 - Detect and escalate data and accounting anomalies that distort the P&L.

3. Be the analytical bridge between credit products, the P&L and planning

vacantes.description:
About Us 
 Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 7 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.
 As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.
 Summary
 As a Senior Software Engineer (Learn) at Platzi you're an engineer first: you build and own systems that hold up in production, and the material you build them with is AI. Orchestration, evals, and the models behind each decision, all serving how millions of students in Latin America learn in the product. You report to the AI Lead. Seniority here means judgment, not distance from the code. You take an ambiguous problem and come back with a decision you can defend, including the decision not to build, and you care about what your code costs to run and to maintain a year from now, not only about getting it merged.
 Requirements 
 Responsibilities 
 Build AI features that ship to students, and own them in production: performance, reliability, cost, and how they recover when they break.
 Design the orchestration behind them: agents, tools and the flow between them, built to be debugged and not just demoed.
 Make evals part of how you work, so you know what improved, what regressed, and what you're trading off.
 Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that's an LLM, a classic model, or plain deterministic code.
 Make architecture decisions you can defend, and say no to complexity that doesn't pay for itself.
 Raise the bar around you through code review, standards, and the calls that stop bad decisions early.
 Requirements 
 At least 5 years building software in production, including owning a system through real scale or a migration.
 Strong fundamentals: data modeling, APIs, performance, concurrency and failure modes.
 You've taken LLM-powered systems to production, not prototypes, and you know where they broke.
 You move comfortably across frameworks like Pydantic, Agents SDK and A2A, and can explain why you chose each one.
 Experience with classic machine learning, and the judgment to know when a model beats a prompt.
 A product you built that we can see and use.
 Fluent English and Spanish.
 Benefits 
 💻 Hardware
 With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.
 📗 Books
 We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too 😉.
 🐣 Maternity/Paternity Leave
 At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.
 💸 Option Pool
 All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.
 🌴 Vacation
 You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.
 💆‍♂️ Online Therapy
 We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.
 🌐 Team Syncs
 Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.
 🏖️ Villa Platzi
 Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face-to-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

About DEUNA 🧡
We are a rapidly growing startup that simplifies global payments and powers next generation commerce in a single platform. With our products we've consolidated hundreds of payment solutions in a single integration, harness an intuitive payment orchestration method and centralize payment reconciliation. 
We are currently present all across LATAM and looking for exceptional talent to join our team and continue revolutionizing the world of payments! 🚀
Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!



About the Role
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer – Data Platform to strengthen DEUNA’s cloud infrastructure, automation, reliability, and observability while supporting the growing needs of our Data Engineering teams. This role will work closely with DevOps/SRE and Data Engineering to build scalable, secure, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure, improve platform resilience, and accelerate delivery through infrastructure automation and DevOps best practices. The engineer will contribute to broader DevOps initiatives while ensuring our data platforms, including Snowflake and MongoDB Atlas, operate reliably and efficiently as DEUNA scales.
Who You Are
3–6+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, or Platform Engineering, ideally supporting production data platforms.
Strong AWS infrastructure and networking experience, including VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53, IAM, cross-account connectivity, and serverless services.
Hands-on experience operating both Snowflake and MongoDB Atlas, including their architecture, access management, networking, backups, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and AWS CDK, along with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Working knowledge of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry, including monitoring and alerting.
Experience with Python and SQL for automation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure operations.
Strong understanding of cloud security, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational reliability.
Ability to collaborate with Data Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and Security teams while taking ownership of shared infrastructure and production reliability.
Proactive, automation-first mindset with strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
What You'll Do
Design, manage, and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and services supporting both DevOps and Data Engineering workloads.
Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and AWS CDK, along with CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
